title: Normative visible-label/name relation
change_reason: Original source-grounded pilot draft; human review pending.
observation: SC 2.5.3 addresses controls with visible text labels: their accessible names must include that displayed wording.
interpretation: Compare visible wording with the computed accessible name for controls that meet this criterion's scope.
scope: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.3, Level A; web controls with labels containing text or images of text.
method: Manual inspection of the linked official document and the named section; original paraphrase, no empirical user test.
limitations: This single criterion does not establish complete WCAG conformance.
No requirement of exact name equality is inferred; inclusion is the normative requirement.
